subject: planner: log merge fix control for multiple ranges (#61976)
summary: Planner-only behavior change: in `skylinePruning`, `SessionVars.RecordRelevantOptFix(Fix52869)` is now recorded only when any candidate access path has multiple `Ranges`, reducing irrelevant Fix52869 attribution in relevant-var/fix tracking (used by binding/plan exploration). The change does not affect access-path pruning/plan selection itself; it only changes which fix-controls are reported as relevant when that recording feature is enabled. No Blocker/High issues found in planner correctness/semantics, and upstream/master keeps the same logging condition (no later fix indicating a regression).
